citation: Liu et al. (2020), Carbon Monitor, Scientific Data, doi:10.1038/s41597-020-00708-7
target: Sum of the six reported sectors, including allocated international aviation; not a complete national GHG inventory.
source_kind: Published activity-based emissions estimates, not direct sensor measurements.
cleaning: Remove entirely empty columns and aggregate regions.
Validate dates, finite non-negative emissions and unique keys.
Sum daily emissions only for complete calendar months.
Keep countries with all six sectors and a continuous monthly history.
Preserve genuine zeros; no interpolation, zero-filling or synthetic observations.
provenance_note: Daily and monthly exports are internally verified. Original source-byte authenticity is independently verifiable only when the original raw snapshot with the recorded SHA-256 is supplied.
